item.title: Chibidol ~Ecchi na Suiei Kyoushitsu~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Ecchira Occhira
  • 発売日: 2014-12-26
  • スコア: なし (2 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ちびドル〜エッチな水泳教室〜
  • 英語名: Chibidol Ecchi na Suiei Kyoushitsu

あらすじ

Freelance swimming instructor Kijima Gunzou receives a request.

It was to give swimming lessons for FruiCHU ☆ Daughter, an idol unit of beautiful girls, who he is a big fan of himself!

Gunzou’s plan was to hide the fact that he’s a fan and get acquainted with the girls in respectful manner, but the girls’ charming bodies keep driving him crazy.
